name: Address normalization, address registries and geocoding
name_ru: Нормализация адресов, адресные реестры и геокодирование
primary_question: Which API or official source should we choose for address suggestions, normalization, geocoding, address validation and building an address database?

decision_paths.notes: Evaluate Yandex Geosuggest and 2GIS Suggest separately when map ecosystem coupling matters.
Use the cleaning API, not Suggestions, for unattended processing.
Choose after testing precision, display restrictions, storage rights and cost.
Treat as official registry/data integration requiring ETL and search logic.

open_questions: What countries and address granularity are required?
Are results displayed to customers, stored long-term, redistributed or embedded in SaaS?
Is the task autocomplete, normalization, geocoding, official registry validation, organization search or routing?
What batch volume, latency and SLA are required?
Which provider permits the intended caching and storage model?
Can the team build and operate an official GAR-based data platform?
